Select the MTD of a gBOIN Trial

Source: R/gboin_select_mtd.R
gboin_select_mtd.Rd

Select the maximum tolerated dose from the final data of one or more trials of the gBOIN design of Mu et al. (2019), in which the toxicity of a dose is the total of the normalized scores of its patients.

Usage

gboin_select_mtd(
  n_pts,
  score_sum,
  target,
  cutoff_eli = 0.95,
  extrasafe = FALSE,
  offset = 0.05,
  min_mtd_sample = 1
)

Arguments

n_pts

Integer vector or matrix. Number of patients treated at each dose. A matrix holds one trial per row.

score_sum

Numeric vector or matrix of the same shape. Total of the normalized toxicity scores, each between 0 and 1, of the patients treated at each dose.

target

Numeric scalar. Target value of the mean normalized toxicity score.

cutoff_eli

Numeric scalar. Posterior probability cutoff for dose elimination. Defaults to 0.95.

extrasafe

Logical scalar. Apply the stricter safety stopping rule at the lowest dose. Defaults to FALSE.

offset

Numeric scalar between 0 and 0.5. Amount by which cutoff_eli is relaxed for the safety stopping rule. Defaults to 0.05.

min_mtd_sample

Integer scalar. Smallest number of patients a dose must have been given to be selected. Defaults to 1.

Value

A data frame with one row per trial and the columns trial, mtd (the selected dose, NA when none is selected) and reason ("selected", "lowest_dose_eliminated" or "no_admissible_dose").

Details

The selection is that of boin_select_mtd with the total score in the place of the number of DLTs: doses whose posterior probability of a mean score above the target exceeds cutoff_eli are excluded together with the doses above them, the mean scores of the remaining doses that were given to patients are made monotone by isotonic regression, and the dose whose estimate is closest to the target is selected. This is the selection of the 'UnifiedDoseFinding' and 'TITEgBOIN' packages. With whole numbers of DLTs as score_sum the result is that of boin_select_mtd.

References

Mu, R., Yuan, Y., Xu, J., Mandrekar, S. J. and Yin, J. (2019). gBOIN: a unified model-assisted phase I trial design accounting for toxicity grades, and binary or continuous end points. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series C, 68, 289-308. doi:10.1111/rssc.12263

See also

sim_gboin, boin_select_mtd

Examples

# Equivalent toxicity scores divided by their maximum of 1.5
n_pts <- c(3, 6, 12, 9, 0, 0)
score_sum <- c(0.5, 1.5, 5.5, 6.0, 0, 0) / 1.5
gboin_select_mtd(n_pts, score_sum, target = 0.47 / 1.5)
#>   trial mtd   reason
#> 1     1   3 selected
